(3) A cup of coffee on the table is knocked over, causing brown liquid to spread across the wood and then onto the light-colored floor. (4) The woman stands in the office holding a sleek black and silver Roborock vacuum cleaner, presenting it with a smile. (5) A close-up shot shows the vacuum head moving across the floor, suctioning the spilled coffee completely. (6) The woman points at the cleaned floor and the vacuum's water tank. (9) A puddle of liquid is seen on the floor near the desk legs. (10) The woman uses the vacuum to clean the liquid mess on the floor. (11) Macro shots highlight the internal rollers and the digital display on the vacuum handle. (12) The woman hugs the dog while her coworkers applaud in the background. (16) The vacuum head moves over the solid noodles and sauce, cleaning the area in one pass. (17) The office staff is shown again, clapping enthusiastically. (18) The woman is back at her desk, reviewing printed documents while her laptop is open. (19) She speaks directly to the camera, explaining technical features. (20) The vacuum is shown on its charging base, with icons illuminating on its circular screen. (21) She shows a clean, dry roller brush to a male coworker. (22) Time passes as she continues typing on her laptop under dim office lighting. (23) The woman walks outside at night on a busy urban street with traffic lights and shop signs visible, talking to the camera.
